text:
During an orderly session, we value your detailed note; we looked into it and saw that your complaint centers on a rough handoff, slow updates, and worry that your companion animal was not given the steady care you expected. We are sorry for that pressure, and we are moving on it right away.

Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. The safety coordinator has already reviewed the boarding path, the crate handling steps, and the cabin checks tied to this trip. The cabin team also confirms that animal watch duties stay active throughout the flight, with direct attention to comfort, water access, and calm positioning.

What failed here was the welcome flow and the handoff between ground and cabin teams. That should not happen, and it is being addressed in the routine desk review now underway. We have reinforced the need for clear status updates, tighter escort handoffs, and faster flagging of any delay that affects a pet or traveler. If your animal was stressed, we want that on record so the follow-up can match the actual issue.

Please keep in touch with the desk if you have any fresh details, because those notes help us fix the process faster. Aurelia Skyways is treating this as a live operations matter, not a casual complaint, and we are pushing for cleaner handling on the next run.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
